Name: Stardio
Author: jokthefoo
Description:
An alternative to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿ for your automation needs!
[b][size=5]
Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][b][size=5]
How to use
[/size][/b]Belts automatically pull items from chests/machines if they are directly pointed away from the chest/machine, and push in if pointed towards chests/machines.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vBLDSxjy/Belts.png[/img]

Belts can be rotated before placement by pressing "R", keybind is configurable if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
Belts can also be rotated after placement by pressing "R" if your mouse is hovering over it in-world.

Conveyor belts are unlocked at Farming level 3, and require 5 iron bars, 25 wood, and 25 stone to craft 5 of them.
Splitters and Bridges are unlocked at Farming level 5 and require 5 belts and 1 gold bar.

Splitters alternate outputting between all available outputs. Bridges allow you to cross belts. Both bridges and splitters can chain, as well as "push" into chests/machines. But only belts can "pull" from chests/machines.

Filter Item -- When items are pushed into it by a belt if they match the filter they will continue forwards, otherwise they will go out the side. To set the item on the Filter interact with the Filter while holding the item. This places the item on top of the filter. The item can be retrieved by either interacting with an empty hand or breaking the Filter.

Built in support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33660]Bigger Machines[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31678]Furniture Machine[/url]!

I was working on a factory mini-expansion and realized I could share these belts as a separate mod. I like automation, but hoppers never
felt very useful. I also like to see the automation so here you go!
